description: De Soto 5-parameter single-diode + Faiman NOCT thermal + empirical DSSC tempco correction. N719 dye on TiO2/iodide electrolyte representative parameters.

module.name: DSSC N719/TiO2/iodide module (10cm x 10cm sub-module, 4 cells series)
module.source: Snaith & Grätzel (2007) Adv. Mater.; Toivola et al. (2009) J. Photochem.; Cameron et al. (2005) J. Phys. Chem. B

alpha_sc.note: +0.3%/K; DSSC Isc increases with T due to better electron injection

NOCT.note: Lower NOCT than Si (low thermal mass of glass/electrolyte)

I_o_ref.note: High I_o due to TiO2/electrolyte recombination; much higher than Si

R_s.note: Series resistance: FTO glass + TiO2 + electrolyte transport; higher than Si

R_sh_ref.note: Shunt through electrolyte leakage and edge effects

EgRef.note: Effective recombination barrier at TiO2/I3- interface (not optical Eg of dye ~1.8eV)

correction_factor.note: RATIONALE: DSSC gamma_desoto_est=-0.42%/K vs measured -0.25%/K. Factor=0.60. Root cause: TiO2/electrolyte recombination weaker T-dependence than semiconductor I_o. Validated vs Snaith & Grätzel (2007) and Toivola et al. (2009).
